text.zh: 赛前，主教练把队长袖标递到你面前：「这支队，交给你了。」
text.en: Before kickoff, the manager holds out the captain's armband: 'This team is yours now.'

label.zh: 扛起整个更衣室，咆哮着把所有人点燃
label.en: Carry the dressing room — roar everyone to life

note.zh: 致敬卡恩、拉莫斯式的咆哮型领袖

background.zh: 卡恩、拉莫斯式的咆哮型队长，用气场与血性点燃全队，是更衣室的精神支柱。
background.en: Roaring captains like Kahn and Ramos lit up their teams with sheer presence and fight — the soul of the dressing room.

label.zh: 话不多，用每一次拼抢和跑动带队
label.en: Few words — lead with every tackle and every run

label.zh: 我只想踢好自己的，袖标给更合适的人
label.en: I just want to play my game — give it to someone better suited

label.zh: 赢了是我带得好，输了是你们的锅
label.en: If we win it's my leadership; if we lose it's on you lot
